sources.title: Самойлов Д.С. и др. Городской скоростной пассажирский транспорт

supports: when deep-level main tracks are in separate single-track tunnels, special connecting tunnels are required and each running tunnel is gradually widened by crossover chambers
crossover-chamber linings may be monolithic concrete, cast-iron tubings or precast reinforced concrete
on Moscow Metro, cast-iron crossover-chamber crowns resting on monolithic concrete foundations with concrete inverts were widely used
reported chamber-crown spans in that Moscow family reach up to 14 m
such crowns use standard station/escalator-tunnel tubings with wedge-shaped cast-iron spacers
a bellmouth is a gradual widening used where a two-track tunnel connects to two single-track tunnels, and the same morphology is used where a connecting tunnel joins through the maximum-span chamber
deep-level turnback tracks use special chambers structurally analogous to crossover chambers, plus large-span chambers for crossover and turnback-track connections
generic deep turnback facilities are described with 12 m track-axis spacing, 1.2 x 1.2 m inspection ditch and 1.2 m-high service platforms, but these are not Belorusskaya junction dimensions

sources.applicability: Moscow metro historical civil morphology and generic deep-junction design logic; not a site-specific Belorusskaya dimensional drawing
